steps.en: Run the official installer script to stand up the Docker Compose stack and an admin account
steps.zh: 跑官方安装脚本，搭起 compose 栈并创建管理员

steps.en: Point your scanner (or a sync folder) at the consume directory
steps.zh: 把扫描仪或同步目录指向 consume 文件夹

steps.en: The consumer picks up each new file, converts it, OCRs scans and extracts text
steps.zh: 一有新文件就接手、转 PDF、对扫描件 OCR、抽取文字

steps.en: Matching rules auto-apply tags, correspondent and type; Tantivy indexes the full text
steps.zh: 匹配规则自动套标签、通信方和类型，Tantivy 建全文索引

steps.en: Search any phrase from any scanned page in the web UI
steps.zh: 在 Web UI 里对任意扫描页做全文搜索

value.en: Years of paper become a full-text-searchable archive on your own trusted box
value.zh: 成堆的纸变成自家可信机器上可全文检索的档案
